text:
opsbot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 tail latency spike detected on continuous-batching path (svc=renderer, region=us-west-2). Automated escalation -> paging eng-oncall. Suspected cause: mixed-seqlen amplification + scheduler fairness regression. Metrics: p95 420ms -> 1.1s, p99 1.6s -> 5.8s. Blocking alerts for streaming stalls. :rotating_light:

sara (oncall): acked. i'm on it — paging matt and jia. any customer pages yet?

matt: oncall here, joining. seeing a cluster of streaming stalls with aborted client streams ~170 errors. can reproduce increased tail on cont-batch traces.

jia: i see packer queue depth spike on hosts gpu-cluster-7 between 03:10-03:25. pack latency up, KV cache miss rate increased for long sequences. looks like mixed-length requests (4k tokens) are dominating a set of workers.

alex: adding infra-bot logs: `gpu-util 85%`, `cuda mem pressure`, `sched queue length 72` on node group cg-7. also noticed scheduler favors larger batch packing that blocks small streaming requests.

opsbot: paging escalation: SLO impact threshold crossed for 2 customer tenants (cs-team flagged). Auto-notify customer-success.

customer-success: we received a support ticket from AcmeCorp reporting streaming tokens stalling mid-stream. they logged a few aborted responses ~03:18. they're asking for ETA. keeping them in loop.

sara (oncall): quick mitigation options: 1) lower max_batch_size for cont-batch in us-west-2 to reduce head-of-line blocking, 2) enable preemptive scheduling to favor streaming lanes, 3) route heavy seqlen tenants to dedicated pool fallback. i'm going to try (1) first.

matt: agree. i can push a config tweak for batch size and bump preemptive weight param. will coordinate with jia for KV evictions.

jia: prepared an evict command to clear long-KV entries on suspect nodes. moving carefully to avoid cache thrash. command:

```
# evict longest 10% of KV entries on cg-7
./kvctl evict --nodes cg-7 --policy longest --ratio 0.1
```

alex: to change batch size (safe hot config):

```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/configs/renderer -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"region":"us-west-2","cont_batch":{"max_batch_size":48}}'
```

sara (oncall): matt, you good to push that to 48 from 128? let's aim for minimal disruption.

matt: pushing now. will monitor p95/p99 and streaming success rate. rolling update across worker groups with 30s drain.

opsbot: CONFIG CHANGE applied by matt at 1723456925: cont_batch.max_batch_size=48 in us-west-2. Watch windows start now (10m).

jia: started KV evict on cg-7 at 1723456940. progress: 60% nodes done. telemetry shows reduced queue depth on those nodes.

alex: early signal: p99 dropped from 5.8s -> 2.1s in 2 mins. p95 back to ~600ms. streaming stalls reduced but still some tail >2s on heterogeneous hosts.

matt: enabling preemptive-scheduler=true for streaming lanes on a subset (canary) of nodes. will expand if stable.

opsbot: SLO alert status: degraded -> stabilizing. customer-impacted list: AcmeCorp (active), BetaAnalytics (minor). sending update to CS.

customer-success: pinged both with interim update: "we've applied configuration changes to reduce head-of-line blocking; monitoring shows improvement; will follow up with root cause once triage complete."

jia: note: observed a scheduler fairness regression in last deploy (roll #2026.03.09). delta: fairness weight default accidentally changed from 0.6 -> 0.4 which allowed large batches to monopolize packer windows. filing rollback candidate.

sara (oncall): next steps: - roll back offending param in planner (rollback id: 2026.03.09) OR standardize fairness weight per-queue; - run a short load test with mixed seqlen profile; - schedule postmortem and client impact spreadsheet. i'm handing off to matt for active monitoring; i'll go take shift notes and start postmortem doc.

matt: taking handoff. will keep scaling preemptively and watch for regressions. if tail rises again i'll open a paging escalation and revert planner param.

infra-bot: monitors: all workers cg-7/cg-8 trending below threshold. no new OOMs.

sara (oncall): final status for now: mitigated -> monitoring. oncall handoff at 04:05 UTC to matt. please file postmortem with timeline, root cause (scheduler fairness param change + mixed seqlens), mitigations applied (max_batch_size reduction, KV eviction, preemptive scheduler canary), and RCA action items (fix rollout gating, add canary for planner param, per-tenant seqlen isolation).

matt: noted. i've created a follow-up task in triage board and assigned to jia/alex for deeper infra fixes. i'll keep CS looped and update ACME with timeline.

customer-success: thanks team — i'll schedule a brief customer sync once root cause confirmed. AcmeCorp appreciates the quick updates. :thumbsup:

sara (oncall): closing the immediate incident thread. leaving watch for next 30m. will escalate if p99 >2s. good job all. :tada:
